description: Row-wise layer normalization (mean-center, variance-normalize, affine transform) using a single Triton kernel. Each program instance processes one row. Measures memory bandwidth (GB/s).

scaling_param.name: n
scaling_param.description: Feature dimension (number of columns per row to normalize over)

non_scaling_params.name: m
non_scaling_params.description: Number of rows (batch × sequence length) in the input matrix

non_scaling_params.name: eps
non_scaling_params.description: Epsilon added to variance for numerical stability

non_scaling_params.name: dtype
non_scaling_params.description: Data type of input and output tensors
